name: Dragons
description: Big flyers with a twist – and the cards that help them.

cards.name: Emberwing Matriarch
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever another Dragon you control enters, it deals 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Hatchling of the Ash Peaks
cards.rule_text:
Flying
{R}: CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Glacier Wyrm
cards.rule_text:
Flying, ward {2}
When CARDNAME enters, tap up to two target creatures your opponents control. They don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

cards.name: Tidecaller Drake
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Gravebound Dragon
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME dies, return another target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Sunscale Guardian
cards.rule_text:
Flying, vigilance
Other creatures you control with flying get +1/+1.

cards.name: Mossback Dragon
cards.rule_text:
Flying, trample
When CARDNAME enters, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Hoard Keeper
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells.
Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

cards.name: Dragon's Roost
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a Dragon spell.

cards.name: Call the Brood
cards.rule_text: Create two 2/2 red Dragon creature tokens with flying and "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."

cards.name: Scales Like Iron
cards.rule_text: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. If you control a Dragon, untap those creatures.

cards.name: Vyrrith, Sky Tyrant
cards.rule_text:
Flying, trample
Whenever a Dragon you control deals combat damage to a player, that player sacrifices a creature and you create a Treasure token.
